basic_info.description: This stunning top-floor condominium is located in a highly sought-after central area, conveniently near GGP, Haight-Ashbury, Alamo Square, USF, & many other attractions. Tucked away at the back of the building, away from street noise, this residence serves as a peaceful retreat, featuring high ceilings & an abundance of natural light. The eat-in kitchen features quartz countertops & stainless-steel appliances. Amenities include a shared backyard, storage room, & a laundry station. This property has been placed in an upcoming event. All bids should be submitted at Xome.com void where prohibited. Please submit any pre-auction offer received through the property details page on Xome.com. Any post-auction offers will need to be submitted directly to the listing agent. Response within 3 business days. All properties are subject to a 5% buyer's premium pursuant to the Auction Participation Agreement and Terms & Conditions minimums will apply. https://vimeo.com/1002895459?share=copy
